description: Synthetic 13CO J=1-0 observations of the mach_grid suite with RADMC-3D (LTE). Physical scaling of the dimensionless isothermal runs: code length = box_length_pc, code density 1 = n_H2_mean, code velocity 1 = isothermal sound speed at T_K.

notes.box_length_pc, n_H2_mean_cm3: Paper I scaling (4.6 pc, 1000 cm^-3); N(H2) = 1.4e22 cm^-2 on average, so 13CO is moderately optically thick in dense regions
notes.mu_sound: mean particle mass for the sound speed (H2 + He); c_s = 0.188 km/s at 10 K
notes.X_13CO: 13CO / H2 abundance; same value as radmc3d_utils.py
notes.channel_width_kms: FCRAO COMPLETE channel width (the Perseus/Ophiuchus cubes have 66.4 m/s)
notes.velocity window: per line of sight: +-(quantile of |v_los| + margin * thermal sigma of 13CO) plus edge_channels emission-free channels on each side, so the observation pipeline's edge-channel noise estimate works
notes.npix_rt: one ray per native cell column; PPV cubes are block-averaged to target_res before beam convolution
notes.beam / noise: applied after RT; distance only enters through the beam size in pixels
notes.molecule_file: LAMDA 13C16O file (downloaded 2026-10-02 from home.strw.leidenuniv.nl/~moldata/datafiles/13co.dat). The older molecule_13_co.inp in p79d_observations is a copy of co.dat, i.e. 12CO, and must not be used.
notes.observe: Named re-observations of the stored noise-free cubes (extract_sim_radmc.py reobserve --obs NAME). fcrao500_v2: contiguous-channel (>=3) masking and 0.2 K noise, matching the measured COMPLETE Perseus noise (0.19 K per 0.066 km/s channel; Ophiuchus 0.37 K).
